'''2004 Georgia State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 22 May 2004 at T & T Toys, 3750 Venture Drive NW, Duluth, Georgia (Atlanta area); [[John Anderson]] announced it on the PC forums. It was six games of Swiss followed by a two-game final confrontation between the top two; the winner received an uncut sheet and a bye into Day 2 of the [[2004 World Championship]]. Twelve players took part, and Dan Brown won.<ref name="pcf-3247">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212648/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3247&amp GA States], John Anderson (2 and 23 May 2004), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 5 September 2004.</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' T & T Toys, Duluth, Georgia<ref name="pcf-3247" />
* '''Dates:''' 22 May 2004<ref name="pcf-3247" />
* '''Announced by:''' [[John Anderson]]<ref name="pcf-3247" />
* '''Players:''' 12<ref name="pcf-3247" />
* '''Winner:''' Dan Brown<ref name="pcf-3247" />

== Results ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Place !! Player !! Swiss record
|-
| 1st || Dan Brown || 5–1 (timed win against Paul Myers)
|-
| 2nd || [[Paul Myers]] || 5–1 (win against Dan Brown)
|-
| 3rd || [[Chris Simmons]] || 5–1 (two timed wins)
|}

Final confrontation: in game 1 Myers's Watch Your Step Raiders beat Brown's Bring Him Before Me by 28; in game 2 Brown's Profit beat Myers's Senate by 30, and Brown was declared State Champion. Three players came from out of town (two from Augusta and one from Florida).<ref name="pcf-3247" />
